titre: TOEIC Grammar 13 — Les propositions subordonnées relatives
description: Who, whom, whose, which, that, where, when. 10 exercices du livret + 22 questions de cours.

questions.question: We are currently working with inspirational organizations ____ the creative economy both in the United States and overseas.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif sujet pour un inanimé : which. Who implique un animé ; whose une appartenance.

questions.question: Melvin Sparks ____ laboratory is based in Cairns is testing the potential of 3-printing to save coral reefs.
questions.explication: Relation d'appartenance (« dont ») : whose.

questions.question: The moment ____ Sylvia de Oliveira went on stage to get her prize was probably one of the most emotional of her life.
questions.explication: Relatif associé à une temporalité : when.

questions.question: The manor house ____ has just flown away was renovated a month ago.
questions.explication: Génitif pour un inanimé : the roof of which (ou whose roof).

questions.question: Anyone ____ family situation has changed due to marriage, divorce, birth of child, or death must complete the following form.
questions.explication: Génitif pour un animé : whose.

questions.question: This bar ____ blends Pop Art style with a souk-like interior offers a delicious oriental music and fantastic cocktails.
questions.explication: Pronom relatif sujet pour un inanimé : which.

questions.question: Skydive directly over the beach in Wollongong and experience the widest blue ____ you will ever know.
questions.explication: Relatif complément d'objet pour inanimé : which, that ou relatif zéro (choisi ici).

questions.question: Reward and recognition practices are seen to be particularly poor in the public and not-for-profit sectors, ____ over two-thirds report they support effective leadership to little or no extent.
questions.explication: Relatif de lieu (secteurs) : where.

questions.question: Each applicant ____ has been granted a visa will be sent their own Visa Grant Notice.
questions.explication: Relatif sujet pour un animé : that (ou who).

questions.question: Our Dutch supplier, ____ we are so fond of thanks to his creative insight, will send his new collection within a fortnight.
questions.explication: Relatif complément d'objet pour un animé : whom.

questions.question: Quels sont les pronoms relatifs anglais cités dans le livret ?
questions.explication: Aussi : pronom relatif zéro (∅).

questions.question: Pour un sujet animé, on emploie :
questions.explication: The grocer that / who sells this produce.

questions.question: Pour un sujet non animé, on emploie :
questions.explication: The menus which / that are indicated...

questions.question: COD animé :
questions.explication: The baby-sitter whom / that / ∅ you hired.

questions.question: COD non animé :
questions.explication: The engine which / that / ∅ the mechanic has been fixing.

questions.question: COI animé :
questions.explication: The child at whom you smiled / whom you smiled at.

questions.question: COI non animé :
questions.explication: The watch for which she's been looking.

questions.question: Génitif (possession), animé :
questions.explication: The engineer whose project is so demanding.

questions.question: Génitif, non animé :
questions.explication: The room whose furniture is all white / the furniture of which.

questions.question: Relatif de lieu :
questions.explication: The café where we had breakfast.

questions.question: Relatif de temps :
questions.explication: The era when dinosaurs lived.

questions.question: Les animés sont généralement :
choix: des êtres humains (et parfois des animaux proches)

questions.question: Les non animés sont :
Who's est :
choix: la contraction de who is / who has
questions.explication: Whose = génitif ; who's = who is.

questions.question: Une proposition relative descriptive (entre virgules) peut-elle se construire avec that ?
questions.explication: On ne peut pas dire *My sister Sybil, that I feel so close to...

questions.question: Le relatif zéro (∅) est possible :
choix: en fonction de complément d'objet (pas de sujet)
questions.explication: Il est impossible en tant que sujet.

questions.question: The man ____ called you is my boss.
The book ____ you lent me is great.
The company ____ CEO resigned is in trouble.
The city ____ I was born is beautiful.
The year ____ the company was founded was 1999.
The girl to ____ I spoke is my sister.
